svg.title: Id Dashboard — Shlok Singh
svg.desc: Hanging ID card with original portrait, decorative barcode and metal clasp. Drops and settles, then swings plus or minus 1.7 degrees. GitHub repository metadata verified 21 October 2026: TEAM_CHECKMATES-GUIDAR primary language Dart, last push 13 June 2026; Signodes-weather-station primary language JavaScript, last push 13 June 2026. No unverified numeric metrics shown.
